name: Bulk update functions
description: Bulk update functions Bulk update functions. PUT /v1/projects/{ref}/functions
context:
PUT /v1/projects/{ref}/functions
Bulk update functions. It will create a new function or replace existing. The operation is idempotent. NOTE: You will need to manually bump the version.
Required: ref (path) — Project ref; body (body)

name: Create a function
description: Create a function This endpoint is deprecated - use the deploy endpoint. POST /v1/projects/{ref}/functions
context:
POST /v1/projects/{ref}/functions
This endpoint is deprecated - use the deploy endpoint. Creates a function and adds it to the specified project.
Required: ref (path) — Project ref; body (body)
Optional: slug (query); name (query); verify_jwt (query); import_map (query); entrypoint_path (query); import_map_path (query); ezbr_sha256 (query)

name: Delete a function
description: Delete a function Deletes a function with the specified slug from the specified project. DELETE /v1/projects/{ref}/functions/{function_slug}

name: Deploy a function
description: Deploy a function A new endpoint to deploy functions. POST /v1/projects/{ref}/functions/deploy
context:
POST /v1/projects/{ref}/functions/deploy
A new endpoint to deploy functions. It will create if function does not exist.
Required: ref (path) — Project ref; body (body)
Optional: slug (query); bundleOnly (query)

name: Retrieve a function
description: Retrieve a function Retrieves a function with the specified slug and project. GET /v1/projects/{ref}/functions/{function_slug}
